subject: any-any-test
message: Rule any-any-test allows any source to any destination on any service (trust to trust).
fix: Replace it with rules for the traffic that is actually needed, then remove it.

subject: rdp-from-internet
message: Rule rdp-from-internet allows the internet to reach 10.0.5.20 on RDP (3389).
fix: Put this service behind the VPN or a gateway, or limit the source to known addresses.

subject: temp-vendor-ftp

subject: temp-vendor-ftp
